prompt: Which movie starring Meryl Streep was nominated for Best Picture at the Academy Awards the year that the Pioneer 11 visited Saturn?
answer: **Kramer vs. Kramer (1979)**. Pioneer 11 flew past Saturn in 1979, the same year *Kramer vs. Kramer* was released; it was nominated for—and won—the Academy Award for Best Picture at the 52nd Academy Awards.
